title: An early parcel in a due-date ledger
abstract: A dispatch ledger records both lateness and tardiness so that an early parcel can be traced through the penalty calculation.

segments.source: A parcel delivered before its due date has negative lateness in the dispatch ledger. The penalty column assigns it zero tardiness. For a late parcel the two entries coincide and the penalty clerk can copy the signed entry directly.
segments.reference_zh: 若包裹在交期前送达，发运台账中的延误时间为负，罚款栏记录的拖期时间为零。若包裹逾期送达，两项数值相同，负责核算罚款的人员可直接抄录带符号的记录值。

segments.source: With dates held fixed, tardiness is bounded below by the parcel's signed lateness, as expressed by <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 在交期不变的情况下，如 <m1/> 所示，包裹带符号的延误时间是其拖期时间的下界。

segments.source: Were the due date moved forward by a day. An unchanged delivery could incur a penalty.
segments.reference_zh: 假如交期提前一天，即使送达时间不变，也可能产生罚款。

segments.source: In the audit, locating a missing receipt takes priority over sorting the receipts by colour.
segments.reference_zh: 核查时，优先查找缺失的收据，随后才按颜色整理收据。

anchors.description: 提前时延误时间为负而拖期时间为零，逾期时二者相等。
式 <m1/> 中包裹的带符号延误时间是拖期时间的下界，允许二者相等。
交期假设提前一天，可能受罚而非必然受罚。
priority 仅指核查事务的先后，不引入调度约束。

title: Idle stations on a short transfer line
abstract: A washer and a dryer can both be idle, yet only one of the two observations qualifies as starvation at the dryer.

segments.source: A washed crate still occupies the washer because there is nowhere to unload it. We record blocking there. At the other end of the line, an empty dryer with no crate ready to enter is idle through starvation.
segments.reference_zh: 洗好的周转箱无处卸放，仍占着清洗机，此时记录为清洗机阻塞。在生产线的另一端，烘干机空着，且没有待烘干的周转箱，此时属于烘干机缺料停机。

segments.source: An empty dryer alone does not establish that the upstream blocking interval was longer than <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 仅凭烘干机空置，无法断定上游阻塞的持续时间超过 <m1/>。

segments.source: No second crate can leave the washer. Unless the unloading shelf is cleared.
segments.reference_zh: 除非清空卸料架，否则第二个周转箱无法离开清洗机。

segments.source: When a crate is on the shelf, the observer marks the shelf as occupied before recording either station.
segments.reference_zh: 如果架上放有周转箱，观察员先标记架子已被占用，再记录两台设备的状态。

anchors.description: 阻塞发生在有箱却无法卸出的清洗机，缺料停机发生在等不到箱子的烘干机。
不能由烘干机空置推出上游阻塞时长大于 <m1/>。
清空卸料架是第二个箱子得以卸出的必要条件。
原条件句完整，有箱时先标架子再记设备。

title: Time charged to a dye lot
abstract: The schedule uses setup time once per dye lot and charges processing time separately for each length of cloth.

segments.source: Changing the bath colour consumes setup time before any cloth enters the vat. Processing time accrues only while cloth passes through the bath. Doubling the cloth length at fixed speed leaves the colour change charge untouched.
segments.reference_zh: 布料入缸前，更换染液颜色所用的时间计为准备时间。只有布料通过染浴时才计入加工时间。走布速度不变时，布长加倍并不影响换色所计的时间。

segments.source: At a fixed feed speed the processing time is directly proportional to the cloth length, as indicated by <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 进布速度恒定时，加工时间与布长成正比，如 <m1/> 所示。

segments.source: Provided the bath retains its colour overnight. Tomorrow's first cut can use the existing setup.
segments.reference_zh: 只要染液隔夜仍保持原色，次日的第一段布就可以沿用此前的准备。

segments.source: A separate ticket instructs the attendant to file the colour card.
Only after the bath has cooled.
segments.reference_zh: 只有在染液冷却之后。

anchors.description: 准备时间按换色计，加工时间按走布过程计。
式 <m1/> 表示加工时间与布长成正比，成立条件是进布速度恒定。
沿用准备工作的前提是染液隔夜保持原色。
编号内只有冷却后的时间条件，换色卡的归档动作留在上一编号。

title: The fate of an interrupted order
abstract: A stoppage notice records preemption or cancellation according to what happens to the unfinished cut after the blade stops.

segments.source: One partly cut roll may return to the blade with its remaining length still booked. That is preemption. A second roll disappears from the order book altogether after cancellation, even if the unused material later goes to another buyer.
Suppose the remaining cut length after preemption is no greater than the length still wound on the roll, as written in <m1/>.
Even though the blade has stopped. A clerk must keep the remaining length on a preempted order.
The inspector signs the stoppage notice. If a roll has changed hands. The clerk signs the transfer slip.

anchors.description: 抢占保留未完成作业以便恢复，取消使作业从订单簿中撤销。
式 <m1/> 中待切余长不超过卷上余长，这是本文的假定而非观测结论。
停刀是让步条件，被抢占的订单仍须保留余长记录。
中间条件可能约束前一签字或后一签字，保留三句的边界及各自的签字人。

title: Slack seen from two milestones
abstract: A repair crew compares free float with total float when choosing how long a noncritical task may wait.

segments.source: Moving a repair within its free float preserves the earliest start of every immediate successor. More room may be available within its total float if a successor can itself move without delaying the finish of the whole project.
A postponement equal to <m1/> exactly exhausts the free float of the repair.
Should the inspection be brought forward. Its new start becomes the limit for the preceding repair.
The foreman's margin reads <m1/> available float. The symbol on its own line is part of the comparison.

anchors.description: 自由时差以紧后任务的最早开始为准，总时差以项目完工为准。
<m1/> 绑定维修任务的自由时差，等长推迟恰好耗尽它。
检查若提前，新的开始时刻便限制前序维修。
<m1/> 以小于等于号结尾，右侧是可用时差，保留同一比较关系。

title: Transfer between adjacent drying racks
abstract: A split batch permits, but does not guarantee, an overlap between two consecutive operations.

segments.source: Dividing a batch of tiles into smaller transfer lots is lot splitting. We reserve lot streaming for the schedule in which a downstream rack starts the first lot while the upstream rack is still treating a later one.
Let <m1/> name the first rack and <m2/> the rack at the far wall. For this trial the load on the first rack must stay below <m3/>.
Small as the first lot may be. Its carrier still occupies an entire rack position.
For rack accounting, carrier and tile cradle share a single inventory label.

anchors.description: 拆批只需划分转运批，流水式分批调度还要求上下游工序对不同小批重叠作业。
<m1/> 与 <m2/> 只给两个架子命名，不蕴含其速率、分布或大小关系。
即便首个小批很小，其载具仍占一个完整架位。
用户指定 carrier 与 tile cradle 均译为“瓦托”。
第一架负荷须严格低于 <m3/>，此限制只用于本次试验。

title: What a vented capsule reads
abstract: Opening a capsule to the room provides a way to distinguish gauge pressure from absolute pressure without changing the indicator scale.

segments.source: Open the reference port to room air and then vent the capsule to the same room. The gauge pressure falls to zero. The absolute pressure inside the capsule still includes the pressure exerted by the air in the room.
segments.reference_zh: 先将参考端口与室内空气连通，再将膜盒腔也与同一房间连通。此时表压降为零，而腔内的绝对压力仍等于室内大气压力。

segments.source: Once the capsule has equilibrated, its absolute pressure equals the ambient pressure <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 膜盒腔达到平衡后，其绝对压力等于环境压力 <m1/>。

segments.source: Had the reference tube been sealed before venting. The zero reading could no longer have been taken for granted.
segments.reference_zh: 假如参考管在放气前已被封闭，就不能再认定示值一定为零。

segments.source: The legend assigns closed to the reference port and open to the capsule vent in the second sketch [12, 15].
segments.reference_zh: 在第二幅示意图中，图例将参考端口标为关闭，将膜盒腔排气口标为打开 [12, 15]。

anchors.description: 敞通同一房间时为零的是表压，腔内绝对压力仍等于室内大气压力。
平衡后 <m1/> 指环境压力，与腔内绝对压力相等。
参考管先封闭是假设，结论只是否定零读数的必然性。
保留 <b> 对应参考端口关闭、<i> 对应排气口打开。
[12, 15] 两个编号及其顺序须保留。

title: Tracing a groove in opposite directions
abstract: A traversing stylus reveals lateral play on reversal and a direction-dependent indication at the same groove depth.

segments.source: At reversal the screw turns briefly without moving the stylus carriage. This lost motion measures backlash. The depth trace also shows hysteresis: at a fixed groove depth the indicated value depends on whether the stylus approached from above or below.
segments.reference_zh: 换向时，丝杠先转过一小段，触针滑架才开始移动。这段空行程可用于测量回程间隙。深度曲线还显示出迟滞现象，同一槽深处的示值取决于触针是从上方还是从下方逼近。

segments.source: The separation of the two depth traces need not be equal to <m1/>, the screw travel lost at reversal.
segments.reference_zh: 两条深度曲线之间的间距未必等于换向时丝杠的空行程 <m1/>。

segments.source: Even if the carriage moves freely after reversal. A difference between approach directions can persist in the depth trace.
segments.reference_zh: 即使换向后滑架移动自如，两种逼近方向之间的差异仍可能出现在深度曲线上。

segments.source: A separate pass covers 75% of the groove and stops before the chipped end.
segments.reference_zh: 另一次扫描覆盖沟槽全长的 75%，在到达有缺口的一端前结束。

anchors.description: 回程间隙是换向后的空行程，迟滞是同一槽深处的示值随逼近方向而变。
对曲线间距与 <m1/> 相等的说法保留“未必”的语气。
换向后滑架移动自如是让步条件，曲线差异只是可能持续存在。
75% 指此次扫描覆盖的沟槽长度，扫描未到达缺口端。

title: Timing a gauge after a pressure step
abstract: A gauge can pass the upper timing mark and still oscillate outside the tolerance band.

segments.source: Our rise time runs from the first crossing of the lower timing mark to the first crossing of the upper mark. The settling time runs from the applied step until the trace enters the tolerance band for the last time and stays there.
segments.reference_zh: 上升时间从曲线首次越过下计时标线算至首次越过上计时标线。稳定时间从施加阶跃起算，直到曲线最后一次进入容差带并保持在带内。

segments.source: For the damped trace, the last entry into the band occurs strictly later than the upper crossing, giving the ordering <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 对于这条阻尼响应曲线，最后一次进入容差带的时刻严格晚于越过上计时标线的时刻，两者的先后关系见 <m1/>。

segments.source: So long as the pen continues to leave the band. Its first return cannot close the settling interval.
segments.reference_zh: 只要记录笔还会越出容差带，就不能把首次回到带内的时刻视为稳定时间的终点。

segments.source: In the timing notes, tolerance band and acceptance strip denote the same shaded region.
segments.reference_zh: 在计时记录中，容差带也称为容许区，两者指同一片阴影区域。

anchors.description: 上升时间由两次首次越线界定，稳定时间由施加阶跃和最终保持在带内界定。
<m1/> 中最后入带严格晚于越过上标线，先后关系仅针对该阻尼曲线。
后续继续越界时首次返回不能标志稳定。
tolerance band 与 acceptance strip 指同一阴影区域，允许用同一译名。

title: Separating warm-up drift from display noise
abstract: A bridge held under constant load can show a slow shift in level as well as fluctuations from one reading to the next.

segments.source: With the bridge unloaded, the centre of the trace creeps upwards as the enclosure warms. This movement is zero drift. The faster excursions about that moving centre are baseline noise and can remain even after the enclosure temperature levels off.
For the quiet interval alone we model the baseline noise as uniformly distributed over <m1/>.
Quiet though the last interval appears. Its centre can still move during a long exposure.
The operator reads the bridge through the glass lid.
Only while the enclosure is closed.

anchors.description: 零点漂移是中心位置的缓慢移动，基线噪声是中心附近较快的波动。
在安静时段采用均匀分布只是对基线噪声的建模，<m1/> 给出区间。
末段外观平静构成让步，其中心在长时间曝光内仍可能移动。
当前编号仅含外壳关闭这一时间限制，不把前一编号的观测动作移入本段。

title: Two distances in a slit scan
abstract: A translated slit allows the spacing of sample positions to be changed without replacing the slit.

segments.source: Marks engraved on the carriage set the sampling pitch between successive slit positions. The aperture width is the width of the opening that admits light at any one position. Adding carriage marks does nothing to narrow that opening.
At each mark the illuminated width is no greater than the aperture width <m1/> when the mask lies flush against the slit.
Supposing that another mark is cut halfway between adjacent marks. The operator can then halve the sampling pitch without touching the slit.
The operator circles the centre mark. Whenever the stage slips. The observer redraws the scale.

anchors.description: 采样间距是相邻位置间距，孔径宽度是单个位置上的开口宽度。
掩模紧贴狭缝时，<m1/> 为照明宽度的上界。
增刻中点刻线是假设，进而可减半的是采样间距。
中间时间条件可修饰前后任一动作，保留原句界及两名操作者。

title: Two thresholds in a reversible switch
abstract: Rising and falling voltage ramps yield different events even when the lamp is the only observable output.

segments.source: Following an increasing ramp, we mark the pickup voltage when the dark lamp lights. We then reverse the ramp and mark the dropout voltage when the lit lamp goes dark. Interchanging these entries would conceal the direction of travel.
We label the rising-ramp reading <m1/> and the falling-ramp reading <m2/> on the worksheet. For this switch the former exceeded the latter.
Whether or not the lamp flickers during the ramp. Only the first sustained change qualifies as the trigger event.
A lamp circuit monitor (LCM) watches the contact. The LCM shares its time base with the ramp recorder.

anchors.description: 吸合电压对应上升时灯亮，释放电压对应下降时灯灭。
两符号分别指上行和下行读数，仅在本次开关测量中前者大于后者，不推广为必然性质。
不论是否闪烁，触发事件只取第一次持续的状态变化。
LCM 指 lamp circuit monitor，并与斜坡记录仪共用时基。

title: Repeated draws from a tray of discs
abstract: Repeated draws separate the bias of a diameter estimate from its sampling variance, even when the tray itself has a fixed composition.

segments.source: Repacking the tray after each draw lets us repeat the diameter estimate against a fixed population mean. Estimator bias compares the mean of those estimates with that population mean. Sampling variance describes how the estimates spread about their own mean.
segments.reference_zh: 每次抽取后将圆片放回并重新混匀，即可针对同一个总体均值反复估计直径。估计量偏差是这些估计值的期望与总体均值之差，抽样方差则描述估计值围绕其自身期望的离散程度。

segments.source: Unbiasedness alone does not imply the variance inequality <m1/>, which would put the sampling variance below the benchmark.
segments.reference_zh: 单凭无偏性，无法推出抽样方差低于基准值这一不等式 <m1/>。

segments.source: Granted that every diameter on the tray is known. A single blind draw still gives a variable estimate.
segments.reference_zh: 即便盘中每个圆片的直径都已知，单次盲抽得到的估计值仍会因抽到的圆片而异。

segments.source: If a disc lands on its edge, the observer lays it flat before reading the diameter.
segments.reference_zh: 如果圆片落下时立在边缘上，观察员先将其平放，然后读取直径。

anchors.description: 偏差以总体均值为比较基准，抽样方差围绕估计量自身的期望计算。
式 <m1/> 将抽样方差与基准值比较；原文否定仅由无偏性便可推出该不等式。
已知全部直径是让步条件，单次盲抽的估计值仍有变异。
仅当圆片立起时需放平，顺序是先放平后读数。

title: Following return slips to a fixed deadline
abstract: A clerk can see an unresolved case at closing time or miss that case altogether, depending on the register used.

segments.source: The closing register lists every envelope dispatched and marks those still outstanding at the deadline. Those marks indicate right censoring of the return times. A register compiled solely from slips returned before closing instead exhibits right truncation because the outstanding envelopes never enter it.
segments.reference_zh: 截止登记册列出所有已发信封，并标记截止时仍未收到回执的信封。对回执时间而言，这些标记表示右删失。若仅用截止前收到的回执编册，则属于右截断，因为尚无回执的信封根本没有入册。

segments.source: For an outstanding envelope the unobserved waiting time to return strictly exceeds the follow-up duration <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 对尚无回执的信封，等到回执所需的时间严格长于已观测的随访时长 <m1/>。

segments.source: In the event that the late slip is eventually found. Its envelope can be matched to the original register.
segments.reference_zh: 如果后来找到了迟到的回执，便可将相应信封与原登记册上的记录核对。

segments.source: The clerk kept copying the outstanding envelope numbers.
Until the closing bell.
segments.reference_zh: 直到收工铃响为止。

anchors.description: 右删失时知道该信封已发且尚未收到回执，右截断时该信封不入册。
<m1/> 属于已观测的随访时长，真实回执时间严格更晚。
找回回执是得以与原登记册匹配的条件。
本编号仅给截止时间，上一编号中抄录行为不随时间短语移入本段。

title: Reporting a colour before the tray is revealed
abstract: A concealed choice of tray makes the marginal probability of a blue draw differ from its conditional probability on a named tray.

segments.source: The marginal probability of drawing blue averages over the possible trays with their selection weights. Announcing which tray was selected changes the question: the conditional probability of blue uses the colour mix in that particular tray alone.
segments.reference_zh: 抽到蓝色的边际概率，是按各托盘的选取概率对其抽中蓝色的概率求加权平均。公布所选托盘后，问题随之改变，此时抽到蓝色的条件概率只取决于该托盘内的颜色构成。

segments.source: Given the chosen tray and a fixed number of independent draws with replacement, we assume that the number of blue discs drawn follows the binomial distribution specified by <m1/>.
segments.reference_zh: 给定所选托盘，在抽取次数固定且各次有放回抽取相互独立的条件下，假设抽到蓝色的次数服从二项分布 <m1/>。

segments.source: Whichever tray happens to be chosen. The clerk must return the disc before making another draw.
segments.reference_zh: 无论选中哪个托盘，记录员都必须先放回圆片，才能再次抽取。

segments.source: The note on the covered tray cites both colour lists [4, 11].
segments.reference_zh: 关于有盖托盘的说明引用了两份颜色清单 [4, 11]。

anchors.description: 边际概率需对托盘加权，给定托盘后的条件概率只取该盘。
<m1/> 对应蓝色出现次数的二项分布，保留给定托盘、固定次数、独立有放回及假设语气。
归还圆片的要求对任一托盘均成立。
[4, 11] 同指两份清单，<i> 仅修饰有盖。

title: Two intervals on a strip of repeated readings
abstract: One interval concerns a fixed population mean, the other the next independent reading taken under the same conditions.

segments.source: Coverage of the confidence interval is assessed by counting how often newly constructed intervals contain the fixed population mean. To assess a prediction interval we instead record whether the next individual reading lies inside the interval issued before that reading was taken.
Assuming a common centre, the proposed prediction interval is wider than the mean interval by <m1/>.
Narrow though the interval around the mean may look. The next reading may still fall well outside it.
The cover sheet reports 90% for the mean interval and 95% for the next-reading interval.

anchors.description: 置信区间覆盖固定总体均值，预测区间覆盖事先未观测的下一次个体读数。
两区间中心相同是前提，<m1/> 为预测区间超过均值区间的宽度差。
即便均值区间窄，下次读数仍可能明显落在区间外。
90% 属于均值区间，95% 属于下一次读数的区间。

title: A rare heavy token in a payout urn
abstract: The expected payout responds to a rare heavy token even when the median payout stays on the common light token.

segments.source: Imagine an urn in which light tokens outnumber heavy ones and a token's mass is its payout. Raising the mass of the heavy tokens increases the expected payout. The median payout stays at the common light value because the ranks have not changed.
The payout variance would be proportional to <m1/>, the squared gap between the two payouts, if the token proportions were held fixed.
As long as light tokens remain in the majority. Increasing the payout on a heavy token cannot move the middle rank into the heavy group.
The ledger lists the payout on one line. When a heavy token is returned. The keeper updates the running tally.

anchors.description: 期望收益随少数重筹码质量增大，中位收益仍取占多数的轻筹码值。
筹码占比固定时收益方差才与 <m1/> 所示的收益差平方成正比。
轻筹码占多数是中间秩仍在轻筹码组的条件。
返回重筹码的条件可接前句或后句，不自行决定其归属。

title: Waiting at an arbitrary inspection instant
abstract: An inspection made between regularly observed renewals divides one interval into elapsed and remaining portions.

segments.source: Starting at the inspection mark, follow the strip to the left until reaching the previous renewal. That distance is the backward recurrence time. The forward recurrence time starts at the same mark but runs rightwards to the next renewal.
We use <m1/> for the elapsed portion and <m2/> for the still unobserved portion at inspection. Their sum equals the length of the interval containing the inspection mark.
Only if a renewal mark lies on each side of the inspection mark. Can both portions be read from this strip.
The strip is unrolled from left to right, with the older marks nearest the clamp. The clamp mark is labelled <m1/>.

anchors.description: 后向再现时间追溯至上次更新，前向再现时间延伸至下次更新，二者起点都是检查时刻。
第一项已历、第二项剩余，其和等于包含检查时刻的更新间隔长度，未给出分布。
检查标记两侧均有更新标记才可读出两段时长，倒装主句归本编号。
左向右展开，较早的标记离夹具最近。 <m1/> 仅标记夹具位置。

title: Reading the output trace of a busy service
abstract: An overlapping service can complete more requests per second without shortening the journey of a single request.

segments.source: Follow a marked request from arrival until its reply leaves the service to obtain request latency. Counting all replies that leave during a fixed observation period instead measures service throughput after division by the length of the period.
segments.reference_zh: 从一个带标记的请求到达服务端时开始计时，到其响应发出时为止，这段时间就是请求时延。在固定观测时段内统计发出的全部响应，再用响应数除以时段长度，所得为服务吞吐率。

segments.source: At saturation the observed service throughput was less than the output link's limit <m1/>, expressed in replies per second.
segments.reference_zh: 在饱和状态下，实测服务吞吐率低于输出链路的上限 <m1/>，该上限以每秒响应数表示。

segments.source: The output rate can be reconstructed from the reply log alone. Assuming that every reply has a timestamp.
segments.reference_zh: 若每个响应均有时间戳，仅凭响应日志便可还原输出速率。

segments.source: Call the interval from sending a probe to receiving its echo the round trip time (RTT). The RTT includes the return path.
segments.reference_zh: 探测报文从发出到收到回显的这段时间称为往返时间（RTT）。RTT 包括回程耗时。

anchors.description: 请求时延对应单个请求的耗时，服务吞吐率对应单位时间发出的响应数。
观测值严格低于 <m1/>，比较对象均按每秒响应数计。
能否仅凭响应日志还原速率取决于是否每个响应都有时间戳。
RTT 是 round trip time 的缩写，必须包括回程。

title: Reading a committed value across a restart
abstract: Two observers test whether an update is visible while the store runs and whether its contents survive loss of volatile state.

segments.source: One reader asks when it can see the new counter value while the store is running. This measures write visibility. The other reader reopens the store after a power interruption and checks the same counter to assess write durability.
segments.reference_zh: 一个读进程检查存储系统运行期间何时能读到新的计数值，以此衡量写入可见性。另一个读进程在断电恢复后重新打开存储系统，检查同一个计数器，以评估写入持久性。

segments.source: A read that returns the new value at <m1/> does not imply that the value was already durable at that instant.
segments.reference_zh: 在 <m1/> 时刻读到新值，不能据此推断该值在当时已经持久化。

segments.source: Provided that the store has finished flushing its pending writes. A restart can probe whether the value survives loss of power.
segments.reference_zh: 若存储系统已将待写数据刷盘，就可以通过重启检验该值能否在断电后保留。

segments.source: The ledger calls the returned slip a commit receipt. The caller files the write voucher with the corresponding entry.
segments.reference_zh: 台账将返回的凭据称为写入回执。调用方将这份写入回执与相应的台账条目一并归档。

anchors.description: 可见性看运行中何时可读，持久性看断电后值能否保留。
<m1/> 是读到新值的时刻，保留不能由此推断已持久化的含义。
在待写数据已刷盘的前提下，可以通过重启检验该值能否在断电后保留。
用户术语优先，commit receipt 与 write voucher 都须译为“写入回执”，指同一返回凭据。

title: When a changed cache entry reaches the backing store
abstract: The destination trace reveals whether a cache forwards each change or defers copying a dirty entry.

segments.source: Two updates are issued to one resident entry. With write-through caching each update is forwarded to the backing store. With write-back caching the entry may absorb both updates before a later eviction sends the final value to the store.
segments.reference_zh: 对同一个驻留缓存项连续执行两次更新。采用直写缓存时，每次更新都会传给后备存储。采用写回缓存时，缓存项可以先接收两次更新，等到之后被换出时再将最终值发往后备存储。

segments.source: For this pair of updates the number of deferred transfers is at most <m1/> if the entry stays resident until both writes finish and is flushed only once.
segments.reference_zh: 若该缓存项在两次写入完成前始终驻留，且只刷写一次，则这两次更新引起的延迟传输至多有 <m1/> 次。

segments.source: Irrespective of whether the first update reaches the backing store. The replay records the issue time of both updates.
segments.reference_zh: 无论第一次更新是否到达后备存储，重放记录都会记下两次更新各自的发出时间。

segments.source: The replay header identifies the workload as Transformer (big) and gives its share of store traffic as 35%.
segments.reference_zh: 重放记录的标头将工作负载标为 Transformer (big)，并注明其占存储流量的 35%。

anchors.description: 直写逐次向后备存储传递更新，写回可合并更新直至换出。
<m1/> 限定延迟传输次数，须保留始终驻留和只刷写一次两个条件。
是否到达不影响记录两次发出时间。
配置后缀 (big) 属于 Transformer 的名称，须连同括号保留。
35% 是该工作负载占存储流量的比例。

title: Why a line moves between cores
abstract: An ownership trace alone does not reveal whether cores wrote a common counter or independent counters placed together.

segments.source: Two cores alternating updates to the very same counter exhibit true sharing. Put a private counter for each core on a single cache line and the ownership traffic may look similar, yet this second pattern is false sharing.
We hypothesize that under alternating writes the transfer count grows in proportion to <m1/>, the number of changes of writer.
No matter how far apart the two counters look in the listing. They can occupy the same cache line after layout.
The observer may sample the line twice in succession.
Even when neither core writes between samples.

anchors.description: 真共享写同一计数器，伪共享写不同计数器且位于同一缓存行。
转移次数与写者更换次数 <m1/> 成正比属于交替写入条件下的假设。
清单上相距很远是让步条件，布局后同处一行具有可能性。
当前编号仅给两次采样之间两核都未写入的让步条件；采样动作属前一编号。

title: Accounting for free bytes in a bounded arena
abstract: The allocator ledger distinguishes unused space inside an assigned block from gaps between the surviving blocks.

segments.source: Rounding a request up to the next block size leaves unused bytes within the assigned block, producing internal fragmentation. A failed request that would fit only if separate free gaps could be joined illustrates external fragmentation between allocated blocks.
The request needs a contiguous gap of at least <m1/> even when the sum of all free gaps exceeds that amount.
To the extent that adjacent gaps can be coalesced. Some rejected requests may become feasible without moving any live block.
The ledger records the old block size. If a neighbour has just been freed. The allocator records the joined size.

anchors.description: 内部碎片位于已分配块内，外部碎片由分散的空闲区形成。
<m1/> 限定单个连续空闲区的最小长度，空闲总量另算。
合并相邻空闲区是有条件的，可能使部分已拒请求可行，无需移动在用块。
相邻块刚释放这个条件可接前后任一记录操作，保留两个记录对象及三个句界。

title: Two limits on the sending rate
abstract: A slow receiver and a crowded link produce different feedback even when both reduce the same sender's output.

segments.source: The receiver advertises how much room remains in its delivery buffer, allowing flow control to protect that endpoint. Signals from busy links instead drive congestion control and can slow the sender while the receiver still has ample buffer space.
Let <m1/> denote the receiver credit and <m2/> the sender's latest estimate of path capacity. During the trace the advertised credit never exceeded the receiver's buffer size.
In case the receiver reports no spare room. The sender is instructed to defer the next data unit.
The receiver reports its credit in bytes, whereas the link monitor reports delivered data per second.

anchors.description: 流量控制保护接收端缓冲区，拥塞控制响应传输路径的负荷。
<m1/> 表接收端额度，实测未超过接收缓冲区容量；<m2/> 仅命名发送端对路径容量的估计。
接收端报告无空间时，发送端推迟下一个数据单元。
接收端额度按字节报告，链路监视器按每秒交付的数据量报告。
